title: Sobolev-Mercer Expansions and Applications to Stochastic Processes
summary: We establish a fundamental extension of Mercer's celebrated theorem by introducing a class of higher-order kernel operators acting on Sobolev spaces $H^k(Θ)$, where $Θ\subset \mathbb{R}^d$ is a bounded domain and $k\in\mathbb{N}_0$ corresponds to the order of weak differentiability. The spectral decomposition of these operators then yields Mercer-type expansions that are optimal in $H^k(Θ\timesΘ)$.
